WEB UI verified end-to-end at 1920x1080 and short 1280x600 viewports: (a) sidebar-profile-link / sidebar-logout / sidebar-settings / sidebar-admin all remain in viewport at 1280x600 with the middle nav scrolling — footer pinning works; (b) admin (semidiepie) sees 21 feature-toggle-* controls on Home + 1 on /live, clicking flips Featured↔Feature and re-fetches; (c) non-admin sees ZERO feature-toggle-* buttons AND no sidebar-admin link, but featured-label pills still render as expected; (d) profile /semidiepie renders profile-live-banner ('SEMIDIEPIE IS LIVE NOW — WATCH') and the header Avatar has the red LIVE ring+pill when the user is live; (e) Home has 15 avatar-live rings when semidiepie (author of many posts) is live. MOBILE Expo web preview is BLOCKED by a preview-infra CORS bug (see backend_issues.critical) — every API call from https://social-hub-dev-4.expo.preview.emergentagent.com is preflight-rejected because an upstream (Cloudflare) proxy rewrites the browser's Origin header to https://social-hub-dev-4.cluster-12.preview.emergentcf.cloud before it reaches Starlette, so the reflected access-control-allow-origin never matches the browser's actual origin. Mobile source code was reviewed and the testIDs (profile-live-banner in ProfileView.tsx:216, featured-label in app/live/index.tsx:76 and PostCard.tsx:137, is_live pill in PostCard.tsx:124) are all correctly wired, but cannot be exercised via web preview until the CORS rewrite is fixed.

critical.issue: Preview-infra CORS: Cloudflare/ingress rewrites Origin header for requests from https://social-hub-dev-4.expo.preview.emergentagent.com to https://social-hub-dev-4.cluster-12.preview.emergentcf.cloud before hitting Starlette. Starlette (allow_origins=['*'] + allow_credentials=True) then reflects that rewritten origin, so the browser rejects the response (ACAO mismatch). Result: mobile Expo web preview cannot make ANY authenticated API call (login, live, feature). Verified with curl -H 'Origin: https://social-hub-dev-4.expo.preview.emergentagent.com' -> ACAO comes back as the cluster-12 host. Real mobile devices using native fetch are unaffected (no CORS on native).

rca of the issue: Mobile-preview CORS block RCA: preflight OPTIONS from browser origin https://social-hub-dev-4.expo.preview.emergentagent.com is intercepted by Cloudflare (cf-ray header confirms edge) which forwards it to backend with Origin rewritten to https://social-hub-dev-4.cluster-12.preview.emergentcf.cloud. Starlette CORSMiddleware with allow_origins=['*']+allow_credentials=True reflects the received Origin verbatim, so ACAO=cluster-12... The browser compares ACAO to its own origin (expo.preview...) and rejects. Reproduction: curl -X OPTIONS -H 'Origin: https://social-hub-dev-4.expo.preview.emergentagent.com' -H 'Access-Control-Request-Method: POST' https://social-hub-dev-4.preview.emergentagent.com/api/auth/login-pin returns access-control-allow-origin: https://social-hub-dev-4.cluster-12.preview.emergentcf.cloud. Same call with any other Origin (e.g. foo.example.com) is echoed back correctly, confirming the rewrite only fires for the expo subdomain.
